demand_series.period: Aug 2023 – Aug 2024 (first year of relaunched aquaviário)
demand_series.source_label: SEMOBI — 'Aquaviário comemora um ano de atividade com marca de 500 mil passageiros' (~500k pax, 22k+ trips, 91% approval)
Governo do ES / SEP — expansion order of service, Mar 2026 ('até dezembro de 2025, o modal já transportou mais de 1,2 milhão de passageiros'; six vessels in operation)

fare_evidence.corridor: Aquaviário system flat fare (Prainha / Praça do Papa / Rodoviária / Porto de Santana) — integrated with Transcol
fare_evidence.fare_local: R$5.10 (Mon–Sat); R$4.50 (Sun); up to 2 free transfers within 1h30 on Cartão GV
fare_evidence.basis: Regulated public-transit tariff from 11 Jan 2026 (+4.08%); aquaviário charges the same fare as the Transcol bus system

fare_evidence.corridor: Baía de Vitória shared premium lancha tour (Praia do Suá pier ↔ Prainha pier loop incl. Ilha das Caieiras stop)
fare_evidence.basis: Live per-seat price, Capitão Grilo 'Encantos da Baía de Vitória', Jul 2026 departures

fare_evidence.corridor: Shared lancha tours, Vila Velha/Vitória (operator's entry price)

fare_evidence.basis: Press-reported per-person range for escuna tours (low end converted; high end ≈ USD 11.83)

fare_evidence.corridor: Private lancha charter, Vitória (up to 7–18 pax)
fare_evidence.basis: Live charter marketplace listings (Navegue Temporada), low end converted

regulator: SEMOBI (Secretaria de Estado de Mobilidade e Infraestrutura do Espírito Santo) — policy, stations and expansion; CETURB-ES — system management, lines 401/402/403 and Cartão GV fare integration; Capitania dos Portos do Espírito Santo (Brazilian Navy) — vessel certification and navigation safety.
annual_basis_note: No official monthly/annual ridership table is published. Two official milestones anchor the series: ~500k pax in year one (Aug 2023–Aug 2024, SEMOBI) and >1.2M cumulative through Dec 2025 (SEP, Mar 2026), implying ~500–550k pax/yr run-rate on the 3-station network. The 4th station (Rodoviária, May 2026) and three stations under construction (São Pedro, Centro, Dom Bosco; R$61.8M) should lift the run-rate; 'soon seven stations' per the state government. FX: 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15).
confidence: high (official milestone counts and regulated tariff from state sources); medium (annualized run-rate interpolated between milestones)
gaps: No published monthly ridership series (SEMOBI/CETURB report milestones via press releases only) — FOI/direct request would unlock a true series
No per-line split (401 vs 402 vs 403) or station-level boardings
Premium ride-hail (e.g. Uber Black Vila Velha↔Vitória) fare comparable not source-verified — omitted rather than estimated
Aquaviário operating-cost/subsidy figures not found in public sources
